definitions.name: rank_number_one
definitions.rule: ranked[0] after sort by (probability_gate_passed asc, -composite_score, -robustness_score, overfitting_risk asc, -profitable_windows)
definitions.filters: Does not exclude failed probability gate — rank #1 may fail gate

definitions.name: select_best
definitions.rule: First row in ranked list where probability_gate_passed == True
definitions.equivalent_to: Highest composite among probability-gate passers (given rank_candidates sort order)

definitions.name: evaluate_acceptance
definitions.rule: All checks true: robustness_improved, numeric mean_auc_gap, mean_expectancy>0, profitable_windows>=4, probability_quality_passed
definitions.current_wiring: Called ONLY on select_best output in optimization_orchestrator.py — not per-candidate scan
definitions.role: Binary PASS/FAIL gate on one candidate today

definitions.name: freeze_bridge_prototype
definitions.rule: Prototype scans ALL ranked rows for acceptance PASS; builds contract on first accepted (Phase 22AI)
definitions.note: Differs from orchestrator which evaluates acceptance only on select_best
definitions.role: Research prototype — not production freeze writer

definitions.name: future_freeze_target
definitions.rule: select_best → evaluate_acceptance PASS → FreezeContract → registry (design intent)
definitions.current_gap: select_best winner fails acceptance on current 28-candidate artifact set
definitions.production_freeze_today: model_registry.freeze_phase9_9_artifacts uses DEFAULT_CONFIG / logistic_strong_reg — unrelated to optimizer
definitions.role: Target production write authority (not yet wired)

definitions.name: runtime_artifact
definitions.rule: Runtime reads phase9_9_best/*; freeze writes hardcoded DEFAULT_CONFIG candidate
definitions.role: Runtime inference authority (read-only load); NOT optimizer winner today

conflicts_detected.evidence: Report stores select_best; freeze_bridge Phase 22AI built contract from acceptance PASS scan
Phase 22AE/22AB: freeze never reads select_best or best_candidate.candidate_id
